text:
incident-bot: PAGE: embeddings-service error_rate > 5% (P1) — multiple 5xx from inference workers in us-west-2
Jules: acknowledged, I'm oncall. checking dashboards and logs now.
Jules: metrics show spike started 10:50 UTC, errors concentrated on model-quantized nodes (q8).
Ben: I can jump in. any recent deploys?
Eva: I pushed a small quant-change for raptor-2 at 10:48 to reduce memory. rolled to 20% canary.
Ben: that matches. can you pause the rollout and revert the canary?
Eva: pausing now. running revert...
deploy-bot: revert deploy raptor-2-quant @eva started (canary). rolling back 20% -> success on 2/2 hosts.
Jules: seeing errors drop from 5.6% -> 1.1% over 3 minutes. latency briefly spiked during revert (3s -> 6s) but customer traffic recovered.
Carmen: support log: enterprise-acct-721 reported 500s for embeddings, created ticket #INC-2984 and notified CSM.
Jules: thanks Carmen — flagging customer impact as "partial" during window 10:50-11:02 UTC.
Ben: taking over the incident for remediation follow-up. Jules, can you hand off everything you captured?
Jules: handoff: root cause likely quantization regression in canary; mitigation revert succeeded. notes: relevant dashboards (links), sample error traces: 
```
error: kv cache OOM in quantized kernel
stack: inference_loop -> compute_attention -> quant_kernel
```
Observed: 20% canary hosts failed, autoscaler retried and caused some cascading 502s to gateway.
Ben: ok. immediate actions: 1) block raptor-2-quant rollout until regression test added, 2) add 5-min smoothing to embeddings error alert to avoid paging on short blips, 3) add canary-level fail-open to avoid sending all traffic to failing canary.
Eva: I'll open PR for revert-policy and add unit/regression test for quant kernel edgecases.
Carmen: I'll follow up with affected accounts and update INC-2984 with timeline.
oncall-bot: postmortem-draft created: https://redwood.company/postmortems/EMP-1778003456 (private)
Jules: propose postmortem meeting tomorrow 11:00 UTC in #incidents-retrospective. Ben/Eva/Carmen pls confirm.
Ben: confirmed. I'll lead remediation tracking board and own alert-rule changes.
Eva: confirmed. will include deployer canary improvements in the PR.
Carmen: confirmed — will join and provide customer impact summary.
Jules: quick draft of alert rule change to minimize noise:
```
alert: embeddings_service_error_rate
expr: increase_over_time(rate(errors[1m])[5m:]) > 0.03 and sum(rate(requests[5m])) > 100
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: p1
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood.company/runbooks/embeddings-errors
```
Ben: suggestion: use combined condition: error_rate > baseline + 3 sigma OR sustained >0.03 for 5m. prevents paging on short spikes.
Jules: action items (owners):
- EV-1: Disable raptor-2-quant rollout until tests added (Eva)
- EV-2: Add regression test and unit coverage for quant kernel (Eva)
- SRE-1: Update error alert to 5-min smoothing + anomaly clause (Ben)
- SRE-2: Add canary fail-open policy to deployer (Ben/Eva)
- SUP-1: Customer outreach + log attach to INC-2984 (Carmen)
- DOC-1: Postmortem and blameless writeup (Jules)
Ben: I'll create tickets and link PRs to the remediation board. expect follow-up by EOD.
Eva: starting PR now, will add tests and mark WIP.
Carmen: added comment to INC-2984 with impact window and next steps.
oncall-bot: postmortem meeting scheduled: incidents-retrospective — Tomorrow 11:00 UTC — invite sent.
Jules: thanks team. closing incident channel for live mitigation. will reopen if anything else pops. please update remediation board as items progress. :white_check_mark:
